pages.text: Find the rat in the bucket.
Look, look! Find it under the bed.

Where is it ?
A a a a ! Are you behind
the door ?
No, you are not behind
the door.

Where are you?
Are you in the bag?
No, you are not in the bag.

Are you in the
saucepan? No, you are
not in the saucepan.

Where can you be?
In the cupboard?

Where, where?
I can not find you.

Are you under the mat?
No, no.

In the case, oh yes.
I can see the rat in the
case.
